messages.content: You are an analog IC designer repairing a low-noise amplifier (LNA) that FAILED its specification after full SPICE sizing. You reason about the failure and propose STRUCTURAL (topology) changes. You output TOPOLOGY ONLY as a small line-oriented netlist; a downstream deterministic tool inserts biasing and sizes every device with a SPICE optimizer. Never invent device values, DC sources, or bias networks -- only the connectivity.

=== SPEC (t2-nb090-noise-0254) ===
description: train-pool-v2 planted task (nb090, noise objective) from search witness t0014-nb090-noise-1
band: narrowband, f0=900000000.0 Hz
gated constraints:
  nf_db      max 1.3486
  s11_max_db max -7.8468
  s21_db     min 20.0708
  idd_ma     max 6.1193
  mu_min     min 1.0

=== ANCHOR NETLIST (the failed circuit, dialect form) ===
```netlist
* lna-a4-twostage: two-stage tuned common-source LNA with LC interstage.
* Lineage: Cha & Lee, "A CMOS 1.9-GHz two-stage LNA / inter-stage-resonance
* narrowband LNA" (JSSC 2003 two-stage tuned-CS family). Bench-v1 anchor,
* NEW transcription for the tightened 17-22 dB gain tiers. Structure-only,
* ZERO component values. Approved family form: ~3 FETs + 3 L + mirror bias
* (kaggle/EXTERNALS-BENCH-CANDIDATES.md L-A4).
* Structure: stage-1 CS NM1 (input DC-blocked C1 straight to the gate);
* tuned drain load L1 to VDD; LC interstage (DC-block C2 + series L2) to
* stage-2 CS NM2 gate; stage-2 tuned drain load L3 to VDD; output DC-blocked
* C3 to VOUT1. Published in-topology BIAS NETWORK: one current-mirror
* reference (R1 -> diode NM3) biases BOTH gates through series feed
* resistors (R2 -> NM1 gate, R3 -> NM2 gate).
* TRANSCRIPTION NOTE (logged): the first draft carried 5 inductors (extra
* input-match L + source-degeneration L); the LNA bench screen
* (max_inductors: 4) flagged it, and the approved family form is 3 L -- the
* draft was trimmed BACK to the approved/published form, not adapted beyond it.
* Approved 2026-09-14 (bench round 1, "approve all").
C C1 VIN1 n1
NMOS NM1 n2 n1 VSS VSS
L L1 VDD n2
C C2 n2 n4
L L2 n4 n5
NMOS NM2 n6 n5 VSS VSS
L L3 VDD n6
C C3 n6 VOUT1
R R1 VDD n7
NMOS NM3 n7 n7 VSS VSS
R R2 n7 n1
R R3 n7 n5
```
